== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (<code>1220_60</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 60), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-60-He_s_All_Yours_Bounty_Hunter.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-hesallyoursbountyhunter-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (V) (Virtual Block 2)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), "official text as of April 27, 2013" ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf]]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]). Icons as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “USED: For remainder of turn, your bounty hunter escorting a captive may make two additional moves (for free if escorting Han). LOST: Your just drawn Carbon-Freezing (or bounty hunter's character weapon) destiny draw is +2.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1220_60</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 2 set mark, slip number 60 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB2-60-He_s_All_Yours_Bounty_Hunter-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B05 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
